text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow morning, we'll be heading back
to the academy from this training camp lodge."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you good at dancing?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, at the end of the anime, the legendary princess
dances with the prince beneath the starry sky.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And they come to realize
that he was actually a legendary Trainer all along.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And they come to realize
that she was actually a legendary Trainer all along.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So, won't you dance a song with me?
Even a folk dance is fine.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Well, even without dancing,
I already know what the outcome will be. Fufu.
